card.name: Words inside dose-resumption instructions
card.fires_on: Small words like "the" after "resume ... at" in dose-reduction or restart instructions, and some digits or colons inside dosing schedules.

modes.label: Resume at the same dose
modes.description: The word "the" right after "resume [drug] at" before "same/next lower dose level".
modes.example: Resume ITOVEBI at<< the>> same dose level.

modes.label: Digits in dose or duration
modes.description: Second digit of a number in a dose, rate, or treatment duration.

modes.label: Linking words in dosing text
modes.description: A colon or small word that leads into a dose amount or instruction.
modes.example: followed by a maintenance dose of<<:>> 1.5 mg/kg once every

card.plain: It fires on little words in dosing instructions, especially when treatment is restarted at the same or a lower dose.
